title: Career Roadmap: Chartered Accountant (Practice)
summary: Career Domain: Business, Finance & Entrepreneurship · Qualification Pathway: Professional Certifications - CA / CS / CMA / ACCA / CFA / CPA-India – Chartered Accountancy (CA - ICAI) · Target Career: Chartered Accountant (Practice)

facts.Current degree: Professional Certifications - CA / CS / CMA / ACCA / CFA / CPA-India

about.label: About this roadmap
about.text: This roadmap was drafted with AI assistance from OneGrasp's related roadmaps and is awaiting expert review. Check fees, dates, eligibility and exam patterns on the official websites before you rely on them.

blocks.text: A Chartered Accountant in practice runs their own firm or partners in one, offering audit, tax, GST, accounting and advisory services to businesses and individuals. Only a practising CA (with ICAI's Certificate of Practice) can sign statutory audits.

items.text: File income tax and GST returns and represent clients
Advise on accounts, tax planning and compliance
Build and manage a team and client base
Build strong accounting and business-law basics
Study accounting standards, tax and audit closely
Complete ICAI's IT and soft-skills courses
Choose a firm with audit and tax exposure
Work on audits, returns and client files
Note how the partner runs the practice

blocks.text: Final and practice: Qualify and start

items.text: Clear CA Final and become a member
Start small: tax, GST and audits for local businesses

blocks.label: Note
blocks.text: Follow ICAI's current scheme for exams, articleship length and course requirements.

items.text: ICAI post-qualification courses (e.g. DISA, FAFD, GST)

blocks.label: Before you enrol
blocks.text: Check the current syllabus, fees and eligibility on the certifying body's official website.
